description:
Delivers an attack with a potency of 100.
Target cannot be incapacitated by this attack.
Additional Effect: Marks target with Interest Captured
Duration: 120s
Interest Captured Effect: Forges a pact with the targeted beast should you succeed in their subdual
Success is determined upon defeating targets under the effect of Interest Captured.
An entry in the Master's Bestiary will be added upon successful subdual, allowing the beast to be summoned as a familiar.
Success rate is inversely proportional to the target's HP at the time of execution. Furthermore, success rate increases if the target is a lower level than you.
Ineffective against targets whose level is higher than your own.
name: Capture

description:
Upon using Borrow, changes to an action dependent on Kinship.

Wave Kinship Effect: Action deals ranged magic damage to a single target
Scale Kinship Effect: Action absorbs magic damage
Soul Kinship Effect: Action delivers an attack that interrupts a single target
